verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a feature for building custom assistants (GPT-style personas with their own instructions and knowledge) or for sharing them. The closest item is a help-center heading about creating and publishing Kimi plugins and skills (kimi-docs-13). That is a related but different extension feature, with no evidence it defines standalone assistants with their own instructions and knowledge bases, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can build and share custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge
